scope: Existing classification HIER telemetry only; no inference, GPU allocation, optimizer update, or server write

semantics.epoch_records: e1, midpoint and final completed epoch; last_geometry describes the last training batch, not full epoch
semantics.tail10: sums of ten complete epoch counters divided by total training attempts; DeLA retains its per-batch mean convention
semantics.hinge_zero: In noncolliding sampled ancestor draws, active means any of three positive hinges; 1-active/noncollision measures simultaneous margin satisfaction, not morphology validity
semantics.per_role: Available only where active_i/j/k_hinges was actually logged; collision draws excluded
semantics.cap_fraction: Mapped-output depth >=4.5999 in c=.1; SO values are last batch, not raw optimizer-parameter overcap fraction
semantics.proxy_forward_clip_count_last: MN40 last optimizer-step tangent parameter norm >2.3 count among512; not full-epoch maximum or mapped-output radius
semantics.cached_fraction: Fraction of sampled triplets using history candidates; repeats counted and candidates may be stale
